newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on commission sales, CBOT.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on commission sales, CBOT.

text.p: WCE canola ended down on CBOT soycomplex weakness and commission sales, traders said.

"There was commission house selling and when beans sold off late we dropped C$2," a trader said. Jan-March spread at $0.70. January futures crush profit margin fell to -38.75 from -37.44 Friday on January soyoil, meal. Volume was 3,480 lots.
Japan bought 4,000-5,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
January canola lost $2.30 to $402.10, March fell $1.90 to $401.60. January flax lost $3 to $361, March fell $2.30 to $363.50 on hedges and commercial liquidation.
Twenty-five December peas fell US$3 on commercial sales.

December feed wheat rose $0.50 to $168 on short covering and no deliveries, March fell $0.40 to $169 on lower Canadian Wheat Board feed wheat price forecasts last Thursday. Fifty to 100 May-July spread at even money. Volume was 700 lots.
Commercials sold 30 December oats down US$1.60 to US$119.
February western barley lost $0.50 to $138.50 on the CWB's lower feed barley prices, March was unchanged at $138 on short covering. Volume was 600 lots.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
